notes.title: Solbane Releases March 31!
notes.notes:
Pilots wanted! Strap up and prepare for Solbane's launch next week! Survive against a rush of bosses by heavily customizing your ship's arsenal with over 50 abilities and over a hundred upgrades!

Choose between 3 classes, each with their own unique playstyle to save the Solar System from the Drone Threat.

[previewyoutube=bdJ6u_mq9as;full][/previewyoutube]

See you on the battlefield, pilot.
Godspeed.
